Scope and player interaction

Create a common-body avatar with approved hair/palette/outfit choices and one of Vanguard, Ranger, Arcanist or Warden. Class selection changes authored starting rules, not an invented race silhouette. The backend commits name, slot and appearance together.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase04committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

SlotList → EditingAppearance → ChoosingClass → ValidatingName → Confirming → Creating → Ready → DeleteConfirmation → RecoveryPending

WBP_CharacterCreate observes results from URPGCharacterRoster. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Class_Vanguard. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
CharacterId: generated UUID, never derived from name
SlotIndex: integer 0..3 initially; unique per account among nonpurged characters
NormalizedName: server-normalized Unicode key; unique under published realm policy
AppearanceVersion: positive integer plus BodyId, HairId, PaletteId, OutfitPresetId
ClassDefinitionId: one of class.vanguard, class.ranger, class.arcanist, class.warden
DeletionState: Active|SoftDeleted|Purged; deletion timestamps are backend controlled

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGCharacterRosterImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_CharacterCreateLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
CreateCharacter(CommandId, SlotIndex, Name, ClassId, AppearanceChoices) -> CharacterSummary|NameUnavailable|InvalidAppearance
SelectCharacter(CharacterId) -> AdmissionTicket|AlreadyOnline|Forbidden
RequestDeleteCharacter(CommandId, CharacterId, TypedName) -> SoftDeleted|Busy
RestoreCharacter(CommandId, CharacterId) -> Restored|RecoveryExpired|NameConflict

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Appearance controls modify only the preview actor. Validate that each selection exists in the client catalog but repeat validation in the backend.
  2. After confirmation, send the command ID, chosen slot and catalog identifiers; generate no authoritative character UUID in UMG.
  3. Backend authenticates AccountId, checks slot/name uniqueness, class availability and appearance allowlists, and inserts character, starting progression, appearance and command receipt in one transaction.
  4. Starter item grants, when enabled in Phase 09, use a unique character-creation entitlement rather than rerunning grants on every login.
  5. Refresh the slot list from the committed summary and resolve preview visuals with the same appearance resolver used by remote avatars.
  6. After disconnect, list/select the existing CharacterId; target zone loads the durable appearance and replicates only safe appearance IDs.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Create four DA_Class_* definitions with display text, common BodyId=body.common and separate class IDs; abilities can be unassigned until the combat phases.
  2. Place Preview_Avatar in L_FrontEnd with collision disabled, no replication, no PlayerState and no authoritative component; use the art resolver in preview mode.
  3. Build WBP_CharacterCreate with a step heading, previous/next controls, class description, name field and preview rotation disabled. Facing preview buttons are discrete direction choices, not a world camera rotation option.
  4. In WBP_CharacterSelect bind Create, EnterWorld, Delete and Restore to URPGCharacterRoster requests. Delete requires typing the displayed character name and explains the recovery policy.
  5. Reopen BP_RPGPlayerController: after admission completes, remove preview widgets, clear pending input and request the initial zone connection; do not manually spawn an extra gameplay character.

Reopen Phase04 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_FrontEnd / Preview_Avatar / Account_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Two simultaneous identical normalized names -> one Created, one NameUnavailable.
Same CommandId with same payload -> same CharacterId; different payload -> IdempotencyConflict.
Hair from unsupported page/body -> InvalidAppearance or a documented cosmetic fallback; no fabricated compatible art.
Delete while character lease is active -> Busy; never remove inventory rows underneath a live session.
Restore name now occupied -> NameConflict and a rename flow; no takeover of another character's name.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Four slots and a 7-day soft-delete recovery window are proposals. Production naming, moderation, privacy and purge policy require explicit review; no paid character slots.

Audit character create/delete/restore and name-policy reason codes. Do not publish account identity in nameplates. Keyboard/controller focus follows the wizard step heading.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
